project.title: Native service admission and own workspace context
project.goal: Admit source-issued service credentials and own context with one atomic current authorization/quota/rate policy
project.scope: Synthetic admitted service native/HTTP; no lifecycle, company fence or full deployment/adapter parity

component.application.description: Native service credential admission and context

boundary.responsibility: Workspace-bound key lookup, current service authorization, atomic quota/rate and bounded own-context receipt
boundary.rationale: Service identity cannot bypass current access or split quota/rate effects across adapters
excludes: Service lifecycle/company write fencing, physical lifetime and full adapter deployment

scenario.normal.description: Source-issued service default/custom/nullable policy yields exact own context and expected usage only

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic WAL/DELETE, source-issued keys and trusted runtime/catalog
scenario.then: Source-issued service default/custom/nullable policy yields exact own context and expected usage only

scenario.refusal.description: Invalid/expired/disabled/malformed/ambiguous/revoked/rate/quota credentials withhold context and roll back usage

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic WAL/DELETE, source-issued keys and trusted runtime/catalog
scenario.then: Invalid/expired/disabled/malformed/ambiguous/revoked/rate/quota credentials withhold context and roll back usage

scenario.preservation.description: Stable own identity/current latest memberships/catalog order/archive retained; nonusage business/user/session/audit preserved

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic WAL/DELETE, source-issued keys and trusted runtime/catalog
scenario.then: Stable own identity/current latest memberships/catalog order/archive retained; nonusage business/user/session/audit preserved

scenario.correction.description: Strict expiry equality/date/numeric bounds, exclusive HTTP service credential and no cookie/legacy fallback; atomic source/MCP corrections explicit

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic WAL/DELETE, source-issued keys and trusted runtime/catalog
scenario.then: Strict expiry equality/date/numeric bounds, exclusive HTTP service credential and no cookie/legacy fallback; atomic source/MCP corrections explicit

scenario.concurrent.description: Final quota race only one commit; writer excludes revocation; late failure/death rollback and actual unknown commit withhold context

scenario.given: Canonical synthetic WAL/DELETE, source-issued keys and trusted runtime/catalog
scenario.then: Final quota race only one commit; writer excludes revocation; late failure/death rollback and actual unknown commit withhold context

output.description: ok:true with own user id/email/readiness flags, workspaceRole and explicit membership companies only

errors.refused: Opaque401 invalid/revoked/expired/quota/rate/access or503 malformed/operational/unknown without context

preconditions: Admitted same-workspace control/catalog lifetime and exact raw service credential
Canonical source API-key config/registry/current access, supported strict typed quota/rate/date facts
postconditions: Current exact service key/registry/access and bounded own memberships projected under writer
Only exact own usage counters/timestamps changed, in one transaction
Known commit only bounded own context; unknown never replay or success
Shared reusable policy for later CLI/MCP, no claim of complete adapters or lifecycle
external_effects: Atomic own API-key usage metadata and post-known-commit context response

authorization.rationale: Service current credential/role and quota/rate effects must share one writer through prepared context and known commit; no stale grant or partial usage
